title.en: MALACAÑANG PMS LIBRARY BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES WHICH PRESCRIBES THE ADOPTION OF THE PHILIPPINE REFERENCE SYSTEM OF 1992 AS THE STANDARD REFERENCE SYSTEM OF SURVEYS IN THE PHILIPPINES

text.en:
The transition period for the integration of old surveys into PRS 92 is
further extended up to the end of year 2010.

The Department of Environment and Natural Resources is hereby ordered to
allocate the necessary funds, issue implementing guidelines, and designate an office which will
oversee the implementation of this Order.

This Order shall take effect immediately.
DONE in the City of Manila, Philippines, this 2nd day of July, in the year of our Lord,
two thousand four.
By the President:
ALBERTO G. ROMULO
Executive Secretary
